# HexPiece 3.6.1

Your answers after 3.6.0. Not tested in game yet: the build, the tests and the previews pass.

**Iron Fist, Z, Meteor Fist: full power every throw.** The cannonball's speed and blast no longer grow with the hold, as you chose:
every throw is the old full hold's (the fastest ball, the 6-block blast and its damage), whether you tap Z or hold it. Holding only
aims; held 4 seconds it still goes by itself. The ability book says so.

**The Quake fruit's N ultimate (Island Breaker)** keeps its own impact frame, as you chose: nothing changed there.

Everything from 3.6.0 is in this version too (the Haki and Ryou colour pages, the thin crooked lightning shooting out every way, the
coat past the elbow, the new lightning sounds one at a time).
